avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left Skate Creek (3,770 ft) and Paradise (5,150 ft) 19 to 20 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Skate Creek
evidence.detail: left May 7; earlier seasons: May 29 (2023), May 26 (2024), May 24 (2025)

evidence.name: Paradise
evidence.detail: left June 15; earlier seasons: June 30 (2023), July 11 (2024), July 5 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Skate Creek (3,770 ft) and Paradise (5,150 ft).

evidence.name: Skate Creek
evidence.detail: 20.5 in on April 3; earlier seasons: 44.7 in (2023), 28.2 in (2024), 36.3 in (2025)

evidence.name: Paradise
evidence.detail: 38.7 in on April 23; earlier seasons: 75.0 in (2023), 61.0 in (2024), 71.8 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 17 and June 10, carried from the melt-out dates at Skate Creek (3,770 ft) and Paradise (5,150 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Skate Creek
evidence.detail: melted out May 7, at the pass elevation; points to April 15 to May 28

evidence.name: Paradise
evidence.detail: melted out June 15, 1,400 ft above the pass; points to April 20 to June 22
